newsitem.title: USA: Rural Cellular sees improved Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Rural Cellular sees improved Q4 results.

text.p: Rural Cellular Corp said on Wednesday its cellular subscribers rose 72 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier and it expects fourth quarter results to improve over the 1995 fourth quarter.

At the end of the third quarter, the company had 39,284 rural Minnesota cellular customers. Market penetration rose to 6.6 percent in the quarter versus 3.8 percent last year and 6.0 percent at the end of 1996 second quarter.
Rural Cellular said it was providing paging services to 5,870 customers in northern Minnesota and eastern North Dakota at the end of the third quarter -- an 82 percent rise from last year.

"The company expects that fourth quarter operating results will improve in comparison to last year's final quarter, which would further contribute to Rural Cellular's record 1996 performance," the company said in a statement.
Rural Cellular reported third quarter earnings of $0.25 a share versus $0.13 last year.
